Why Wheat Leaves Turn Yellow (Gehu Mein Peele
Patte / Gahu Pane Pivli Padne)
1. Nitrogen Deficiency: Pale yellowing starting from older lower leaves indicates Nitrogen deficiency. Top-dress Urea (remaining half dose of 60 kg N/ha) immediately after first irrigation at Crown Root
Initiation (CRI, 20-25 days). 2.

ion at Crown Root
Initiation (CRI, 20-25 days). 2. Waterlogging / Poor Drainage: Standing water after heavy irrigation causes root oxygen stress and
uniform yellowing. Drain excess water promptly from the wheat field. 3. Yellow Rust (Pila Gerua / Tambere) & Zinc/Sulfur Deficiency: Yellow pustules arranged in stripes on
wheat leaves indicate Yellow Rust fungus. Spray Propiconazole 25 EC at 1 ml per liter or
Tebuconazole 25.9 EC at 1 ml per liter of water.

120:60:40 kg/ha. Six critical irrigation stages: CRI (21 days), Tillering (45d), Jointing (65d), Flowering

Aphids, Mava, and Sucking Pests in Rabi Crops
Symptoms: Aphids and jassids suck sap from tender shoots and lower surfaces of leaves, causing leaf
curling, yellowing (pane pivli padne), and black sooty mould due to honeydew excretion. Biological and Organic Control: Install yellow sticky traps (15-20 traps per hectare).

all yellow sticky traps (15-20 traps per hectare). Spray 5 percent

infestation. Chemical Control (Approved): If pest population crosses Economic Threshold Level (ETL of 10-15
aphids per plant), apply Thiamethoxam 25 WG at 0.3 gm per liter or Imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.5 ml per
liter of water. Always wear protective gear during application.
